s: First, the basics. Call options give holders (buyers) the right, but not the obligation, to buy a stock in the future at a price set today. Puts, on the other hand, give holders the right to sell a stock in the future at a price set today.

t: Trading calls & puts - Robinhood
s: Long calls and puts are the most basic of all the options strategies, and perhaps the easiest to execute because, well, they’re generally a lot cheaper than the stocks they’re attached to (and simpler to understand). Like stocks, you buy a call or put based on your opinion of the stock’s trend, and then sell them at some point, hopefully for a profit.
